researchTasks: [Medium] Reconcile GPT-4 vs Azure AI provider description; age and ownership: Please clarify the current model/provider architecture, age/consent for AI features, retention, generated quiz ownership and admin visibility of prompts/outputs. (route: Vendor privacy contact; evidence wanted: AI Trust Center, terms, DPA, product documentation)

Confirm current pricing, market availability, integrations/standards, accessibility, security evidence and commercial relationship. Complete blank AI fields from current vendor terms/help/trust documentation; record a separate source per field.
Ask vendor (Minimum learner age): What minimum age applies to AI content-generation features, and how are parental consent and student accounts handled?
Ask vendor (Staff can review AI output before learners see it): Can school admins review AI prompts and outputs and configure student access by age/role?
Ask vendor (Staff can see learner conversations): Can school admins review AI prompts and outputs and configure student access by age/role?
Ask vendor (How it responds to learners): Is the AI designed to coach learners with questions/hints, follow educator-defined behaviour, or provide direct answers? Can this be configured?
Ask vendor (Answers from your own course content): Are source citations exposed to learners or authors for generated questions?
Ask vendor (Shows its sources): Are source citations exposed to learners or authors for generated questions?
Ask vendor (Who owns what the AI produces): Who owns AI-generated questions, quizzes and images, and what licence does Kahoot! receive?
Researcher note (pedagogy), not shown until sourced: Vendor says generated content may be inaccurate/biased and the author remains responsible for review.
Researcher note (outputOwnership), not shown until sourced: Official product and privacy documentation needs deeper review before recording model, age, retention, oversight and ownership.
